scope: Read-only PE layout and full .text explicit-reference scan for texture address candidates; no allocation or game-runtime ownership claimed.

proof_levels.pe_layout: STATIC_LAYOUT from pinned PE section metadata and file-backed ranges
proof_levels.host_explicit_references: STATIC_SCAN across decoded x86-32 .text operands; raw numeric candidate scan is not pointer proof
proof_levels.upload_move_addresses: BOUNDED_EQUIVALENT receipts for finite A710/A8F0 cases, limited to tested ordinary-domain inputs
proof_levels.alternate_page_selection: STATIC_CODE plus bounded AC60 page-mask fixtures for FT4/GT4/E1 discriminators
proof_levels.clipped_sprite_uv: BOUNDED_EQUIVALENT geometry fixtures; wider-than-byte U/V means page0 is not a read bound

alternate_index_derived_interval_not_ful.selection_note: AC60 alternate branch writes the fixed base 0xA6E6E0 after computing ordinary page offset; it does not add the page index in that branch.

alternate_high_y_a710_a8f0_write_envelop.proof_level: STATIC_EXPRESSION; y>=512 excluded from bounded upload/move oracle

alternate_page2_address_interval_aliases.rasterizer_scratch_observed: 0x00a9091c..0x00a90a1a and other explicit host globals also lie in this page

0x004365a0.label: pointer cell aliasing host callback source table

0x00a909fc.label: current selected texture-page pointer / sprite U cursor

normal_upload_formula.domain: 0<=x and x+width_words<=1024; 0<=y and y+height_rows<=512; fully contained rectangle
normal_upload_formula.high_y_static_branch: for signed y>=512: row=0x1000+(y&0x1ff), so for x<1024 its address envelope is [0xA6E6E0,0xAFE6E0); this lies in alternate sampler pages 0..8 and overlaps page-2 host state. This branch is outside the bounded normal-input proof and does not establish intended alternate-page upload semantics.

high_y_collision_witness.proof: static address expression only; no fixture executed this input

alternate_page_selection.alternate_page_base: 0xA6E6E0; alternate branch overwrites the ordinary page result, so tpage page index is ignored in alternate mode
alternate_page_selection.fixture_limit: Existing FT4/GT4/E1 page-mask fixtures test tpage 0x80/0x100/0x180, all with page selector zero; nonzero ordinary page selection is established statically by the indexed add sites only.
alternate_page_selection.wide_sprite_uv_escape_note: Sprite clipping can add negative-x/y offsets to U/V without byte masking. First source row is selected_page+U+(V<<8); later rows add 0x100 and mask only the row offset to 16 bits. The byte-UV page0 window is therefore not a proven bound for clipped-sprite accesses; see pinned sprite_geometry evidence.

reciprocal_table_initializer.writes: R[0]=0 at 0xA8E918; R[1..2047]=0x40000000/i as DWORDs, ending at 0xA90914; exclusive end 0xA90918

selected_page_pointer_alias.meaning: AC60 loads the selected page base here; sprite raster paths can change it to selected page + adjusted U. This is mutable pointer/state in alternate page 2, not texture storage.

explicit_refs.decoder: Capstone x86-32 linear sweep over raw .text with skipdata enabled; only decoded non-skip instructions contribute operand refs.

0x004365a0.label: pointer cell aliasing host callback source table

nontext_dword_value_candidates_in_page_s.interpretation: Not classified as pointers from value-range membership alone. Hits can occur inside adjacent 16-bit data/PE metadata.

explicit_refs.callback_table_candidate_interpretation: Raw-value matches are candidates only; machine-code operand context and callback table initialization must be considered separately.

proof_limits: The full .data virtual tail is BSS-backed PE image memory, not a dedicated texture allocation record.
Address spans do not prove pages were initialized/populated or that the whole bank is used.
Static explicit-reference scan cannot bound indirect/dynamic pointers or external DLL writes.
A710 high-y and negative signed-WORD paths are outside the normal domain, and alternate-bank population is not proven.
